models.name: discrete DiT model (maze navigation and Sudoku)

main_sampler.description: EB-Sampler: masked tokens sorted by the entropy error proxy, the largest prefix whose summed entropy minus its maximum entropy stays below γ = 0.1 is unmasked in one function evaluation; zero temperature; Full max_gen_len = 512 with generate_until applied as a post-process

credited_component.text: EB-Sampler, an adaptive sampler that decides which and how many tokens to unmask per step via an entropy bound

design.inherited_from: Dream 7B Base (D01, D02, D04, D05, D06); Top-k samplers (Chang et al., 2022; Kim et al., 2025; Zheng et al., 2023) (D08)

census.F2_detail: Blanket experiment-level sentence: zero temperature sampling for all experiments (§6), so argmax values. Positions are ranked by the entropy error proxy and the number unmasked per step is set by the entropy bound γ = 0.1; with the token rule stated this adds no letter. Algorithm 1 writes sample(p) but the experiment statement overrides it. generate_until is a post-process. Other rows (Top-1, γ = 0.001, semi-AR columns) not coded.

units_h.benchmark_printed: standard coding and math reasoning benchmarks
